items.title: Joseph 'One Eyed Babe' Phillips Interview, 1957-03-27
items.q: The interviewee does not speak in this turn; the mention of Clutchy is in the interviewer's narrative about a fire incident.

ctx.x: Well, they said, fellow, you know they had moss in the hall, all dry. You know how they're decorating them Chinese lanterns. And they said some smart aleck throws a cigarette up in the moss, and they'd cock. But a lot of them got out because I have a cousin. He's sharing that. Clutchy got out and got Hattie out. She run back to get a whole straw she had. She just bought a can and wanted to show it out there. She got burned up. Did they have many doors or windows or something? One door.
They nailed up all the windows. They say one door, but they said a lot of people could get saved there if it went through that smoke.
